turns.message: On July 20, 2022 I ordered Adidas Runstunner running shoes on the Flipkart app. They were listed at a discounted price of Rs 975, down from Rs 4,999. The very next day Flipkart cancelled my order without any valid reason and without my consent. I tried Flipkart's customer care to ask why and to get the seller's details, but they did not help and would not address the cancellation. I then went to the National Consumer Helpline.
